scope: 0119 part on the HyperMesh 0.5 mm voxel HEX8 (centre-inside filtered), flash reading A' with grouped flashes -- FAST variant of 0119-flash-voxel.json (fewer laser-off substeps, mechanics-aligned outputs)
purpose: Accelerated rerun of the v159_voxel production. Deviations from 0119-flash-voxel.json: hold_substeps 10 -> 6, recoat_substeps 10 -> 5 (13 rows per flash instead of 22), mechanics every_steps 22 -> 13 (still one solve per flash), thermal_output_every 0 + mechanics_output_every 1300 (bucketed mechanics-aligned VTU saves so every snapshot carries a current stress state). Flash energy grouping, materials and process parameters unchanged.

mesh.note: HyperMesh voxel lattice 0.5 mm (mode 3) filtered to centre-inside voxels (convert_hm_voxel.py), rotated to +Z, raft = 2 voxel layers

layer_schedule.activation_rule: activate a 0.5 mm slab when its first flash starts; 5 flashes per slab, each carrying 2.5 real (40 um) layers of energy and clock (12.5 real layers per slab)
layer_schedule.flash_grouping: energy per flash per cell mass = validated 0.2 mm reading

scan.scan_time_rule: t_scan(layer) = A(slab) / (hatch x speed): full-area hatching, contours and jumps excluded

flash.power_rule: commanded(layer) = P x t_scan(layer) / (t_flash x capture(slab))
flash.note: reading A' (D-V2-11): the whole physical layer's energy P x t_scan is flashed in the cell dwell time 0.2 mm / 650 mm/s, then laser-off hold sub-steps span the rest of t_scan. The legacy Gaussian exp(-2 rho^2/r^2) with r = 1 m over a 96 mm part drops 1.0 % centre-to-corner; capture(slab) is evaluated on the mesh (sum over the slab's cells of A_cell x exp(-2 rho^2/r^2) x 2/(pi r^2)), so deposited energy per layer equals Ac x P x t_scan(layer) by construction and the ledger measures it.

thermal_mechanical.release_rule: raft cells cut (stiffness and locked-in stress removed) + 3-point rigid-body anchors on printed nodes; bottom Dirichlet temperature held at the preheat value through cooldown

runner.heat_source_note: depth band re-derived for 0.5 mm cells under the vertex rule: cutoff 499 um (< slab), d = 314.182 um, discrete band integral 1.000000

mechanics.note: 13 rows per flash (2 flash + 6 hold + 5 recoat); one mechanics solve per flash = 5 per 0.5 mm slab
